base: Using the attached photo of this exact dog as the likeness reference (keep her face, eye shape, nose, ear length and fluffy cream coat recognizable), create a front-facing head portrait of this fluffy cream Bichon-style poodle: round cloud-shaped head, long fluffy drop ears, big dark round eyes, black button nose, happy open mouth with pink tongue out. Head and ears only, centered, perfectly front-facing and symmetrical, isolated on a plain flat white background, designed as a bold t-shirt graphic. Absolutely no text, no letters, no words, no watermark, no signature, no frame, no people, no collar.
